answer: Grading-robustness gate breaks script graders. The ledger serves a juror a near-identical twin of an answer just scored, synonyms swapped and clauses reordered, then re-asks grade. A human reads meaning and gives the onyx of an unchanged verdict; a bot flips its call on the twin because it keys on surface tokens. A sybil river of cloned graders trips when its verdict self-contradicts, and the cluster is slashed. To pass, an operator must field N genuinely understanding graders per wallet, not one brittle script the oasis of paraphrase breaks. Cost: real comprehension surviving edits, times N.
